Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: PoC trial plan — deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Hi Sam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next-step plan so we can align on deployment mode and PoC success criteria.

Summary of your needs (as I heard them):
- Data residency & compliance requirements for PII and audit logs (PRD, SOC-2 scope)
- High reliability for customer-facing inference (p99 latency target ~200ms for short completion flows)
- Predictable unit economics — you want to compare Hosted API cost versus Dedicated reserved capacity
- Security team leaning toward Private VPC for production, but open to an initial Hosted evaluation for speed

Suggested PoC/trial approach:
1) Quick Hosted trial (2 weeks) to validate integration, latency, and basic regression tests against your prompts.
2) Parallel sizing exercise for Dedicated capacity (throughput and token budget) so we can quote reserved costs.
3) If security requires, run Private VPC feasibility and network checklist during weeks 2-3.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Integrated end-to-end call from your app to Redwood API and back (sample traffic)
- Latency: p95 under 250ms for 0-512 token prompts
- Quality: no regressions vs baseline prompts (your test set)
- Security: checklist items completed for Private VPC if required

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (outline + timeline), network_requirements.xlsx (VPC/NAT/ports). Please review and share the one-page SSO/network contact for your infra team.

Proposed timeline:
- Kickoff: week of Jun 21 (30–60 min)
- Hosted trial: 2 weeks following kickoff
- Dedicated sizing + quote: delivered within 3 business days of sample traffic

Next steps for you:
- Confirm success criteria above or shoot edits back
- Share primary technical contact for network/VPC and security reviewer (cc Priya or similar)
- Approve kickoff window (week of Jun 21)

Thanks — I cc Marissa (solutions engineering) who will own the PoC runbook and measurements.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Appreciate the clarifying notes, Sam — updated plan below and next actions.

Updated success criteria (incorporating throughput):
- Integration: sample traffic end-to-end
- Latency: p95 under 250ms for 0-512 token prompts
- Throughput: steady-state 80 rps; sustained bursts to 250 rps (we'll size based on tokens/sec)
- Quality: pass your prompt regression set
- Retention: logs retained 90 days, exportable for audits

Dedicated sizing guidance (initial estimate):
- For 80 rps steady / 250 rps bursts with avg 150 tokens: recommend 4x A10x or 2x A100-style nodes with batching and KV cache enabled. Exact sizing requires a short perf run with a 10k-sample workload.

Proposed PoC schedule (detailed):
- Week 0 (Jun 21): Kickoff + credentials + technical onboarding
- Week 1: Integration and smoke tests (Hosted API)
- Week 2: Performance run and tuning; collect logs and metrics
- Week 3: Security review & Private VPC feasibility (if requested)
- Week 4: Final validation, handoff, and if moving to Dedicated, procurement paperwork

Attachments: updated redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (contains runbook + measurement templates) and network_requirements.xlsx (ports, CIDR, SSO notes).

Requests for Acme:
- Introduce Priya to Marissa and the infra contact who will handle VPC peering / NAT rules
- Share any baseline prompt set for regression checks (we can accept a spreadsheet or S3 link)

If that all looks good I can lock in a 30-minute kickoff on Jun 22 or Jun 23. Marissa — can you prep the runbook and send a short readout we can use for Priya?

Thanks,
